senses.gloss: f. (preced.) low growth, corn in its earliest stage used instead of grass.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 2:1">Peah II, 1</cite> <he>הקוצר לש׳</he> he who cuts young corn to be used as fodder; <cite ref="Tosefta Peah 1:8">Tosef. ib. I, 8</cite>.

Men. X, 8 (71ᵃ) קוצר לש׳ ומאכיל לבהמה (Bab. ed. מאכל, corr. acc.) one may cut barley as shaḥath and give it to the cattle (before the ʿOmer has been offered); Tosef. ib. X, 32 קוצר לש׳ עד שלא וכ׳ as to cutting barley for fodder: before it has approached maturity by one third, one may begin &c.
<cite ref="Menachot 71b:5">Men. 71ᵇ</cite> <he>כל לש׳ לא וכ׳</he> whatever is for fodder is not considered as harvesting.
